body:
We have spoken about this requirement before but bottom line is that this doesn't seem to belong in "Credential Recovery"

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **[2.5.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x11-V2-Authentication.md#v25-credential-recovery)** | [MODIFIED] Verify that default user accounts (e.g. "root", "admin", or "sa") are not present in the application or are disabled. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 798 |

I think we have a few potential target locations:

* Option 1 - [V2.2 General Authentication Security](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x11-V2-Authentication.md#v22-general-authentication-security) - This doesn't really fit anywhere else in V2 otherwise.
* Option 2 - [V14.6 Web or Application Server Configuration](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v146-web-or-application-server-configuration) - This could be considered configuration as it is not necessarily something that is coded into the application but I think this is a weaker choice

What do people think? @elarlang

comments.body:
V2 is "do authentication correctly". If default credentials are used, from V2 perspective it is handled correctly.

For me it is a V14 issue.

Not a perfect match, but V14.1 deploy is dealing with "do not put test-code", "debug modes", "demo functionality" etc to the production. But this is just the first idea, does not give "let's go for the PR" feeling.
This is more user policy than general authN so I agree v14 seems better.
I do not find it shocking to find it in V2. V14 is probably OK as well.
V14 seems like a fine fit.
V14.1 gives me the best vibes here, opened PR #2403
